name: Flip Disc Checklist
description: Dark diagnostics card with a checklist whose checkboxes are 3D flip discs. Checking an item flips the disc to a glowing amber checkmark and lights up the label.
contents: List of checkable rows, each with a flip disc and a label
behavior: Clicking a row toggles it and flips the disc around the X axis with a 3D transition
Checked labels change color and gain a soft glow
Rows highlight on hover and the disc shows a focus outline for keyboard users
editableByProps: Title, item ids, labels and initial checked state, number of items
Card, disc and label colors through Tailwind classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glow color of the checked disc and label
needsCodeEdit.where: box-shadow and text-shadow classes on the back face div and the label span
duration-700 class on the preserve-3d div

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Card max width is 333px and max height 444px with inner scroll
